instruction.thesis: OIL NO position on WTI hitting LOW $90 in May has moved severely against us — WTI spot has risen from $96.88 at entry to $101.02 (+4.27%), and the current PM price is 0.64 vs entry at 0.40 (60% loss). The signal-family evidence metric oil_wti_spot has moved decisively in the wrong direction. With WTI now above $101 and the Brent-WTI spread compressing to 3.7, the probability of WTI touching $90 in May has declined further, but the NO contract has already repriced to reflect this. The thesis that WTI would not touch $90 is still directionally correct (WTI is moving away from $90, not toward it), but the PM market has repriced the NO contract upward due to the overall bullish oil move. However, at 60% loss and with oil funding turning sharply negative (-11.79%), indicating crowded longs that could unwind, and the Brent-WTI spread at historic lows (3.7), there is structural risk of a sharp oil reversal that could move the NO contract further against us before expiry. The ONE_TOUCH_HIGH_EDGE_NO signal has only 0/1 wins historically. Closing to preserve capital given the 60% loss and uncertain path to expiry.
